name: ETH 2x
status: in force from 2026-10-08 once the inception decision 2026-10-08-qeth2x-paper-inception is anchored (see decisions.jsonl) — stage A: a rules-only synthetic level of a daily-reset 2x book from Binance spot bars, one line per UTC day, and a testnet mark vault holding test dollars; nothing is borrowed, swapped or liquidated.
_doc: Stage A rules for ETH 2x (keeper/leverage-index.mjs). The rulebook is rulebooks/qeth2x.md in this repository; the inception decision pins this file's sha256. check.minutes and check.trigger are the output of the sixth pre-registered leverage test (site repository, research/leverage-params-v6, registration 8b355b7, results/results.csv.gz row trk_asset_outcome,ETH,A,own,all: best). The values hold for stage A only: a real borrowing book needs a new verdict against the real liquidation line. Changing any value after a decision pinned this file is a rule change: a new decision, never an edit.

underlying._doc: Closed 1-minute bars of the UTC day, aggregated to 15-minute bars by the sixth test engine's --build rule; no fallback source; a day with fewer than 1,440 bars halts until a person accepts it in keeper/leverage-gaps.json.

product._doc: Product definition (owner 2026-10-01): twice the UTC-day return of the underlying, leverage brought back to 2.0 at every 00:00 UTC close; between resets the trigger only reduces leverage.

check._doc: Sixth test output, owner track, which for ETH equals the free track (no interval set by the owner); ETH opened on the same day as BTC by owner decision of 2026-10-05; decision region from 2017-09-01 confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-05: chosen ETH|2|daily|L>=T|n = ETH|2|daily|L>=2.3|30. Check times are every n minutes from 00:00 UTC (the one grid phase the test measured).

model.lltvNote: placeholder — no market's value is confirmed; the tests count a liquidation at a bar low at this LTV as a total loss

level._doc: The cost convention of the recorded level, set by the owner on 2026-10-05 (30 bp, 4.5% a year; the tests' headline is 6%): costBp per unit of traded notional, charged out of equity at each trade; at every 15-minute bar the debt is multiplied by (1 + ratePct / 100 / 365) ^ (elapsed minutes / 1440). level.also = further conventions recorded on the same line, each with its own book (none).

fees._doc: A price, not a tested value (owner, 2026-10-05): no management fee in stage A. The level carries no fee and the testnet vault contract has no fee function; this key records the decision and drives nothing.
